text:
During an eventful shift, thank you for your feedback; we looked into it and found that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal during check-in and the lack of clear guidance you received before departure. We are sorry for the distress this caused. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is set up to keep traveling pets safe and to make the process clear for passengers, and that standard was not met in your case.

Our review showed that the desk record did include the pet travel note, but the handoff between staff members was not handled with the care expected at Aurelia Skyways. That kind of gap can leave a traveler uncertain and a pet unsettled, and we understand why that raised concern. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and when those priorities are not explained in plain language, the service falls short.

We have reminded the team to give clear guidance before departure, to confirm any pet comfort needs, and to speak promptly and respectfully when concerns are raised. We have also reinforced the need to check all companion animal documents before the traveler reaches the gate area, so that avoidable confusion does not carry forward. This is routine desk work, but routine only helps when it is done carefully every time.

Your report was useful because it pointed to a service break we can address without delay. We will use it in staff review, and we will continue to monitor how the desk supports travelers with companion animals, including cases like Gus, where calm handling and clear direction matter most. If you return to Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will be ready to assist with a more consistent handover and clearer communication from the start.

We regret the inconvenience and appreciate that you brought the matter forward. Companion Animal Travel Desk
